local_lemmas: A physical rotation transports its whole-frame label. Only its promoted child's old label can be SET-lost; only its demoted pivot's new label can be SET-created. Duplicate A labels suppress changes.

At a B bit, the lost proper label contains the actual KEEP target and is A-absent at target-rooted post-A. The created label excludes the target. Consequently every B bit has SET potential change zero or minus one.
A terminal B zig decreases. A double at the global B root has a full-side output and therefore cannot be fully neutral.

A live proper B label survives outside KEEPs and is removed by its first inside KEEP. Whole double frames strictly expand along that splay, so a run supplies at most one demand. Different neutral demands have distinct original B creators.

For each neutral frame, A-absence holds at both endpoints of Pi because A's root is inside that proper frame. For a fixed label the Pi windows of different demands are disjoint, including cyclic lifts.

parametric_complete_obstruction.all_constants_refutation: For any finite real K choose p=q=s with integer s>8K. Then s^2>8Ks, so this complete-source cut rejects load K. This refutes existence of any finite constant for this policy, not merely capacities one or two.
parametric_complete_obstruction.optimum_sufficiency: Every subset using r lower and c upper indices has at most rc demands and exactly 4(r+c) neighbors. rc/(r+c)<=pq/(p+q). Capacitated Hall holds at the displayed integer capacity; finite integral flow gives an assignment.
parametric_complete_obstruction.forced_other_work: Any unrestricted load-K charge must fund at least pq-4K(p+q) selected demand units through edges that do not change that consumer's cover label. For fractional funding, this bounds the amount sent through such edges.
parametric_complete_obstruction.not_a_global_cost_counterexample: A grows as 4*2^(p+1)(q+1). No unbounded U_int/A ratio is established. No new A work or virtual credit is introduced.
